name: Architecture Clarity
description: The tool's NKP data accurately reflects the system's stress surface and residual architecture
phase_state: Stressors are well-defined; terminology is complete; iteration captures current architecture with Ri > 0

name: Terminology Drift
description: Domain terms accumulate without definitions or become inconsistent across files
phase_state: Traits fail validation; terminology.csv grows stale; operator sessions produce contradictory terms

name: Skill Staleness
description: Installed skill files diverge from embedded skill definitions in the binary
phase_state: Operators work from outdated methodology; skill-check reports version mismatch

name: Data Fragmentation
description: residual/ files become inconsistent — stressors reference nonexistent attractors; traits have no terminology basis
phase_state: verify all returns violations; git hook blocks commits; no way to run FMEA

name: Residuals Incongruence
description: The residual/ data diverges from the actual project state — stressors reference obsolete components, traits fail validation silently, and skill sessions produce analysis grounded in fabricated architecture
phase_state: verify returns violations; tag scan shows unregistered stressor references; skill-data surfaces stale or empty metadata

name: Fluent Architecture Capture
description: Metadata additions land in the right place regardless of session phase or explicit skill invocation — the tool meets the operator where they are, minimizing cognitive overhead of maintaining accurate residuals data
phase_state: Stressors and purposes are added mid-conversation without phase ceremony; verify passes; iterations reflect reality rather than a prescribed workflow cadence

name: Software-Only Tunnel Vision
description: Residues are assumed to be code changes; stressors better answered by hardware, process, or policy zig are forced into brittle software zags
phase_state: positive: operator examines whole-system-residue before software patches; negative: operator commits to a software fix first
